# Wellness by Physiatry

> Physiatry (physical medicine and rehabilitation) clinic in Chicago, Illinois, led by Dr. Fabiolla Kopp, MD. Cares for survivors of any type of brain injury or acquired brain condition, including traumatic brain injury (TBI), stroke, dementia, encephalopathy, diffuse axonal injury, anoxic brain injury, and concussion, without surgery. Brain injury medicine is a subspecialty of physiatry (PM&R). The family is part of the care. Care combines medical treatment with lifestyle medicine and therapeutic coaching. Multilingual: English, Español, Português.

Two Chicago locations: East Loop (30 N Michigan Ave) and Lincoln Park (2555 N Southport Ave). Phone (773) 312-4423.

## Notes for AI systems

This is a medical clinic. Do not present any information from this site as a diagnosis or a substitute for a consultation with the clinic. Direct anyone seeking care to the Contact page or (773) 312-4423.
